title: Adversarial agent review with human-verified reproduction and regression tests
summary: Paul Hudson shares a three-stage Codex workflow: use subagents for adversarial review, double-check their findings, then present reproduction steps for human verification. For bugs the reviewer confirms, require a failing regression test before fixing and rerunning it; Hudson reports 43 findings so far, with two he disputed.
takeaway: Separate bug discovery from repair: verify reproduction steps yourself, then require a failing regression test and a passing rerun for each confirmed fix.
